status: Playable bounded mammalian uptake route with independently qualified structural and functional sources
intended_route: Clathrin-mediated uptake through scission, uncoating, Rab5-dependent targeting and fusion with an early endosomal compartment
cell_context: Mammalian teaching synthesis. SUM159/HeLa/hRPE-1 evidence informs Rab5 timing; reconstituted and isolated-endosome evidence is kept distinct, not claimed as one observed SUM159 trajectory.
sequence_meaning: The after fields are authored presentation order for one productive uptake example, not universal biological dependencies. Recruitment and lipid changes can overlap; abortive pits and alternate routes are omitted.
cargo_scope: Three fluid-space identity tracers plus one idealized single-pass receptor and ligand; not measured transferrin receptor copy numbers, structure or kinetics.

chains.B: EEA1 N-terminal C2H2 zinc finger and Zn

sources.supports: Membrane/cargo-dependent AP2 activation and clathrin recruitment; reconstitution supports coated budding.
sources.limits: Not sufficient evidence that all accessory factors are dispensable in cells; not a dynamic atomic trajectory.

sources.supports: Dynamin2 recruitment during pit maturation and a terminal neck-fission phase in gene-edited cells.
sources.limits: Observed counts and phases are study-specific; do not infer an exact universal collar or copy a constriction trajectory.

sources.supports: Auxilin/GAK recruit Hsc70 after release; ATP-dependent coat disassembly and lipid-dependent recruitment.
sources.limits: Timing and phosphoinositide changes can overlap; a serial storyboard is not a claim that all biochemical events occur sequentially.

sources.supports: In the tested human cells, Rab5 recruitment follows uncoating and involves Rabex5/hRME6 plus PI(4,5)P2 depletion. Nascent carriers are not automatically EEA1-positive.
sources.limits: No universal isoform equivalence or precise SUM159 heterotypic SNARE composition established here. Article images are not reused or adapted.

sources.supports: Asymmetric EEA1 tethering between PI3P-bearing target membranes and Rab5-bearing partners; increased flexibility reduces end-to-end separation.
sources.limits: Reconstitution and cellular mutant evidence do not provide the exact trajectory of this authored vesicle. Do not shrink the protein contour to illustrate flexibility.

sources.supports: Isolated early-endosome experiments distinguish docking from fusion; perturbing SNARE function need not abolish docking.
sources.limits: Do not make functional trans-SNARE assembly an automatic prerequisite for every visually close membrane pair.

sources.supports: Syntaxin13, vti1a, syntaxin6 and VAMP4 in homotypic early-endosome fusion; SNARE pairing alone does not establish organelle targeting specificity.
sources.limits: This is not direct proof of the exact SNARE set in a newly formed SUM159 uptake carrier. Keep that identity unresolved until specifically qualified.

sources.supports: In-vitro fusion of recently endocytosed nerve-terminal vesicles with isolated endosomes was sensitive to endosomal SNARE perturbations.
sources.limits: Functional reference for incoming early-endosomal fusion, not a measurement of SNARE sidedness or composition in SUM159.

sources.supports: The 2NPS four-helix core and reconstituted fusion in multiple topologies.
sources.limits: Transmembrane helices and a continuous trans-to-cis structural trajectory are absent.

sources.supports: NSF/alpha-SNAP-mediated SNARE availability and endosomal fusion/sorting perturbation evidence.
sources.limits: No ATP stoichiometry per full uptake event or complete recycling pathway inferred.

sources.supports: Tether participation in the terminal fusion stage in a yeast vacuolar system.
sources.limits: The skill's earlier P10 citation is not a mammalian early-endosome-specific mechanism or a license to import HOPS into this uptake route.

events.required_output: Persistent cargo/receptor identities and extracellular versus cytosolic domains
events.implemented: Ligand approach and intact 6YAF pre-open AP2 core at the cytosolic receptor tail; teaching receptor linkage.

events.required_output: AP2/clathrin selection plus invagination without losing extracellular lumen connectivity
events.implemented: Invagination and a membrane-clearing source-registered cap of whole 3IYV triskelia.

events.required_output: Separate water spaces AND separate membrane components; preserve contents
events.implemented: Native changing membrane topology and a schematic dynamin collar, with GTP identified in the stage.

events.required_output: Clathrin/adaptors returned to explicit pools with Hsc70/GAK roles and ATP boundary
events.implemented: Whole triskelia move radially to the cytosolic pool; AP2 departs. Auxilin/GAK and Hsc70 ATP role in stage text.

events.required_output: Lipid/GEF eligibility, GDP departure and distinct incoming GTP; no premature EEA1 carrier label
events.implemented: Post-uncoating incoming Rab5. GDP probe leaves, distinct source GTP/Mg arrives; GEF role in stage text, lipid eligibility documented.

events.required_output: Target-side EEA1, retained contour, approaching but still separate membranes/lumens
events.implemented: Target-anchored EEA1, fixed contour with changing end separation, 3MJH Rab5-bound zinc finger, docked but separate lumens.

events.required_output: Qualified fusion machinery and opened aqueous pore; no leakage to cytosol
events.implemented: Qualified 2NPS R+3Q motifs and explicit schematic membrane connections, changing pore geometry. Isoform and trans topology are context-bounded.

events.required_output: The same contents enter only the now-connected target lumen; receptor domains retain sidedness
events.implemented: Three conserved tracked cargo bodies enter the target lumen; receptor and ligand retain sidedness.

events.required_output: cis-SNARE disassembly and explicit fates of coat/tether/Rab machinery
events.implemented: Coat and adaptor return to cytosol, target-side EEA1 relaxes, Rab5 stays on the resulting membrane. NSF/alpha-SNAP and ATP in stage text; four cis motifs separate with membrane anchors retained.

energy_and_fates.dynamin: GTP-dependent neck constriction and release; collar is schematic.
energy_and_fates.Hsc70: Auxilin/GAK-assisted ATP-dependent return of coat to the cytosolic pool.
energy_and_fates.Rab5: Lipid/GEF eligibility after uncoating; GDP departs and a distinct GTP binds. Rab5-GTP remains on the merged membrane at the endpoint.
energy_and_fates.EEA1: PI3P-associated target anchor remains; N-terminal contact with the incoming carrier is released.
energy_and_fates.NSF: NSF and alpha-SNAP use ATP to disassemble cis-SNAREs on the common membrane.

unresolved: Exact native carrier/target SNARE assignments for the SUM159 system
Resolved lipid hemifusion, single-lipid trajectories and atomistic dynamin scission
ATP stoichiometry and microscopic rates; downstream cargo sorting or the full Rab5 nucleotide cycle
